basic_profile.bio: Based in Seattle, I am a 36-year-old software engineer with a passion for gaming and collecting vinyl records. I enjoy reading and set a goal to finish a book every week. My evenings are usually spent raiding in Pokémon Go or discussing the latest Taylor Swift vinyl releases. I have a partner who is equally a fan of Pokémon, and we often team up for raids. I typically browse Reddit during my lunch break and late evenings.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and work as a software engineer, which gives me a strong foundation in technology and problem-solving. My interest in vinyl records and music has led me to self-educate on audio equipment and music history.
